Name: Kenneth's Buffs Crops
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Buffs Crops[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This addon adds 11 buff crops to Kenneth's Seed Shop. They are crops that actually do something when you eat them.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The crops included are Energy Root, Four-Leaf Clover, Magnetic Fruit, Ocean Starfruit, Persian Shield, Pick-Axe Flower, Radioactive Onion, Radioactive Parsnip, Snapdragon Skull, Speedy Bean, and Strange Bulb. All of them have custom lore descriptions written to feel like they belong in the game.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]There are six editions. They all use the same seeds and descriptions, the difference is how strong the buffs are. You should only install one.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The six editions:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Sproutling Edition - 1x Balanced[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]The baseline version. Normal buff duration and stats. Made for players who want it to feel close to vanilla balance.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Fairy Blessing Edition - 2x[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]A light boost over balanced. Double the buff power. Good if you want a small edge without going overboard.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Witch's Garden Edition - 4x[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Stronger, more magic-focused balance. Four times the base values. For longer buff runs and heavier farming.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Devil's Harvest Edition - 6x[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This is where it starts to get heavy. Six times the base values. Named devil because the buffs are already pretty strong here.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Demon Overlord Edition - 8x[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Even stronger. Eight times the base values. For players who want their crops to carry a lot of weight.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Archangel God Crops Edition - 10x[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]The strongest edition. Ten times the base values. This is the god tier if you want your buffs to last and hit hard.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Seeds are sold in Kenneth's Seed Shop all year[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- You can choose where they are sold: Shop1, Shop2, Shop3, Shop4, or Shop5 via GMCM. Default is Shop4[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with base game seasons, regrow is included where it makes sense[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Note on edibility[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]These crops are not set up as regular food with health or energy values. They have 0 edibility and are there for the buffs only. You eat them for the effect, not for healing.[/b][/size]
